messages:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up: propose an API field `precision_candidates: [string]` and a deterministic normalizer that produces a stable `coalesce_key` for caching KV/batch. Goal: bound keyspace while preserving client intent.

alex: How do you prevent permutations from blowing up keys?

maya: Rules: clamp to 3 candidates, canonical alias map, sort by explicit priority then default rank. pseudo: `bucket = join(sorted_canon[0:3], ':') ; coalesce_key = sha256(model|route|bucket)`

liam: Ops: pin hash+sep in proto to avoid accidental churn. also add namespaced key versions (v1/v2) and a `coalesce_key_miss_rate` metric.

jin: Runtime telemetry: emit `{coalesce_key, chosen_profile, quality_delta_estimate, safety_triggered}`. If bad_count(coalesce_key) > X in window, move to safety lane (force `fp16`) and start 1% shadow-run.

alex: SDKs should expose client-side normalizer to reduce server churn; add header `X-Precision-Override: forced-fp16` when safety lane active.

maya: Rollout: 48h logging only -> 72h shadow 1% -> 5% canary with safety enforcement -> ramp. I'll write RFC patch with proto change, normalization table, metrics, and runbook.

ops-bot: Checklist created: reviewers=[maya,alex,liam], unit tests for normalizer, fuzz permutations, dashboards+alerts (:white_check_mark:).

liam: Add alert: `precision_coalesce_cardinality_spike` if unique coalesce_keys/minute spikes > threshold. Schedule review 10:00 tomorrow.
